question: A 34-year-old man who consulted in the emergency department for dysuria and burning in the urethral meatus, with the presence of a thick and thick discharge that exits through the meatus for 3 days. Which of the following answers is FALSE?

options.opa: A sample of the urethral exudate must be obtained to make the etiological diagnosis.
options.opb: Empirical treatment will be performed with intramuscular ceftriaxone and azithromycin orally in single doses, pending microbiological results.
options.opc: Antibiogram should be performed in cases in which N. gonorrhoeae is isolated.
options.opd: At 2-3 weeks after the administration of the treatment, new urethral samples must be obtained to confirm the microbiological cure.
